_note: Portable PaperOrchestra backend config. Pick ONE backend; the runner dispatches every step to it. Secrets can use `env:VARNAME`.
//backend: one of: api | openclaw | claude-code | codex
//api_driver: opencode | aider — the OSS agent CLI that gives the OpenAI-compatible model its tools
//vision_model: a VLM for the plotting critique loop + section-writing multimodal call + the self-verify render-and-LOOK pass (G4); null => those degrade to text-only / deterministic-only
//image_model: optional text->image model for generated diagrams; null => matplotlib-only figures
//web_search: how the literature agent discovers candidates: builtin (host tool) | searxng | serper | none (degraded: user-supplied refs.bib only)
//s2_api_key: optional Semantic Scholar API key (env SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY) to raise the 1 QPS public limit — recommended for deep-survey snowballing
//survey_depth: literature depth: shallow (one discovery round, default) | deep (citation-graph snowballing to saturation via snowball.py — for survey/study papers or exhaustive related-work)
//figure_fix_max_iters: bounded regenerate loop for patent/concept drawings that fail the image gate (color/shading/border/size + crowding/objects-too-close geometry)
//figure_context_chars: reference-figure-extractor: chars of surrounding context kept around each in-text figure mention
//skills_dir: null => use the PaperOrchestra skills VENDORED in ./skills (MIT); set a path to override
//parallel_2_3: run plotting (step 2) and lit-review (step 3) concurrently; set false on single-session backends
//require_meta: block drafting until the human-only meta (paper: venue/double-blind/authors/audience; patent: inventors/assignee/jurisdictions/filing-type/prior-art/public-disclosure) is in inputs/meta.json — the runner exits 3 with machine-readable questions the driving agent must ask the user; false opts out
//self_fix: after compile, feed self-check defects (overfull/clipped tables, missing figures, unresolved refs) back into a bounded backend fix loop; reverts any iteration that regresses
//layout_remedy: deterministic FIRST pass for overfull: inject preamble microtype + URL hyphenation + \emergencystretch (fixes many boxes at once, scales to large docs); kept only if it does not worsen overfull
//proofread: run the OPTIONAL bounded model proofread in the mechanical-verify stage (typos + translation-nuance + wrongly-translated technical terms); advisory only, never edits content
